name: mil188qammod
expr: rt16 = isequal(x16, mil188qamdemod(mil188qammod(x16, 16), 16)); rt32 = isequal(x32, mil188qamdemod(mil188qammod(x32, 32), 32)); rt64 = isequal(x64, mil188qamdemod(mil188qammod(x64, 64), 64)); y256 = mil188qammod(x256, 256); rt256 = isequal(x256, mil188qamdemod(y256, 256)); rtN256 = isequal(x256, mil188qamdemod(y256 + 0.005*(1+1i), 256));
comment: MATLAB mil188qammod / mil188qamdemod (MIL-STD-188-110 QAM). Bit-equal with MATLAB R2025b on ALL FOUR supported constellations: M=16, 32, 64, 256. All tables hard-coded per MATLAB's spec-rounded values (probed at %.17g). MIL188 cluster CLOSED 4/4. Octave 11.1.0 doesn't ship mil188qam in core; reports N/A.
